about.heading: A quieter kind of beauty.
about.lede: Elora is a daily ritual wardrobe for face, body, and scent. Fewer notes. More intention. Formulas you will actually finish.
about.story_body: We edit until the ritual is quiet. No extra steps for the sake of a routine. Cleanse, treat, protect, rest — the same pieces, every day, until they disappear into how you move.
about.value_one_body: Short lists. Recognizable names. Nothing added to perform.
about.value_two_body: Each formula has a job. If it does not earn its place, it does not ship.
about.value_three_body: Textures you will actually finish. A scent wardrobe that sits close to the body.
about.close_heading: Start with the ritual you already have.
about.close_body: Build a quiet lineup, or walk the full collection.
